indicator.title: Pashu Aadhaar tagged - Goat
indicator.description: Number of goats tagged with Pashu Aadhaar (NDLM) in each district. Pashu Aadhaar is the UIDAI-style 12-digit tag issued by the National Digital Livestock Mission to individual animals; the count here is a count of tags issued, NOT an estimate of the actual goats population of the district. Coverage varies by state as the rollout is in progress.
indicator.notes: Hans honest-renderer: tagged count is NOT a livestock-population estimate. Indicator carries renderer_rules=[no_rank_table] in the canonical catalogue. Animals without a recorded total are skipped (NDLM may emit null totals for species with only male xor female counts present). Each row's `time` is the raw NDLM vintage selector (`2024` for CY 2024, `2024-25` for FY 2024-25); the canonical adapter decodes this to (period_label, year, period_seq).
